label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user-provided) written to HTML response via response.getWriter().format(...). The data flows from request.getHeader("Referer") through URL decoding and into a HashMap, then retrieved and used in a formatted string that is sent to the client. No encoding or sanitization occurs before the sink, making it vulnerable to XSS.

evidence.note: User input from request.getHeader("Referer") is captured into param
Param stored in map and retrieved as bar
Bar (containing user input) used in response.getWriter().format()
